title.narrative: Scaling-up of high impact interventions in the fight against HIV/AIDS - Tajikistan (01-Oct-2015-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Tajikistan, HIV, United Nations Development Programme (UNDP Tajikistan)This program has the following goals: To achieve universal access to HIV services; prevention, care, treatment and support that enables people with HIV to live a fulfilling life. The objectives of this program are: Ensure high quality and coverage of prevention services for key populations (PWID, SW, MSM, prisoners, including their partners). Ensure quality care and treatment for the people living with HIV/AIDS and TB. Health System Strengthening by integration of health service delivery and optimisation of human resources. Programme management: capacity development of MoHSPP and support of procurement and supply management. Strengthened supportive environment to improve access to services for Key Population
